facts.claim: Amazon values customer obsession and ownership.
facts.quote: United by our peculiar culture of curiosity, bold ownership and fearless initiative, we channel our customer obsession into making everyday impact—big and small.

facts.claim: Amazonians share a drive to impact the future.
facts.quote: Every Amazonian, from warehouse floor to corporate HQ, shares a drive to impact the future, today.

facts.claim: Application and interview processes vary by role.
facts.quote: Our application and interview process differs from role to role.

facts.claim: Candidates can review common technical topics before software interviews.
facts.quote: Learn about the most common technical topics covered in our software development interviews.

facts.claim: Amazon describes AWS as the world's most comprehensive cloud platform.
facts.quote: AWS is the world's most comprehensive cloud, enabling organizations to accelerate innovation, reduce costs, and scale more efficiently

signals.text: Frame supported candidate evidence around demonstrating customer obsession and ownership.
Frame supported candidate evidence around delivering impact at scale.
Prioritize evidence tied to the role and business unit over generic company values.
When JD coverage and claim safety are equal for AWS-scoped roles, prefer the supported bullet demonstrating cloud infrastructure work aligned with Amazon's stated AWS positioning.
